sentences.text:
Applicant :- Kali @ Atul
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Kumar Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
So far as service of notice is concerned, the victim herself has annexed her affidavit with the present
bail application, therefore, notice is deemed to be sufficient.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 362 of 2020,
under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Ajeetmal, District Auraiya with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It is submitted by learned counsel for applicant that applicant is innocent and has not committed any offence as alleged in the first information report.
The victim in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she has not made any allegation against the applicant.
She stated her age to be 19 years.
She further stated that she herself married with applicant and having a child of five months.
The victim in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she reiterated her version as of 161 Cr.P.C. and stated her age to be 18 years.

It is also stated that the victim was given in the 'Supurdagi'
of her mother-in-law.

As per High School certificate the date of birth of the victim is 10.07.2004 and Kali @ Atul vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122686117/

sentences.text: according to it she is aged 18 years.
It is further submitted that there is no evidence available against the present applicant.

Apart from the present case, there is criminal history of one case against the applicant being case crime no.22 of 2023, under sections 147, 307, 323, 504 IPC, P.S. Sahar, district Auraiya, in which the applicant is on bail.
Learned counsel for applicant lastly submits that applicant is in jail since 26.02.2023 and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Per contra learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid aspect of the matter.

Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, at this stage, prima facie, a case for bail has been made out.
The prayer for bail is granted.
The application is allowed.

Let applicant, Kali @ Atul, involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2).
The applicant will not influence any witness.
(3). The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.

Order Date :- 18.5.2023 Prajapati  Kali @ Atul vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122686117/
